review_kind: read-only source review; AST parse; no new media execution or optional tests
scope_accepted: One frozen historical TRAIN clip raw-media diagnostic

checks.cohort_identity_pinned: Exact COHORT and IDENTITY hashes plus raw-media size/SHA before use
checks.verified_bytes_consumed: FrozenInput.read_bytes returns the hashed byte copy, passed on stdin
checks.pcm_crop: ceil lower sample index and floor exclusive upper sample index; clock/index must equal frozen prior; native diagnostics precede cropped-only resampling
checks.frame_pts: Eligible frame inside origin..origin+0.5s, decoded showinfo PTS independently checked within 1 microsecond, no selected frame past 1s prefix end
checks.subprocess_safety: Explicit argv arrays, no shell; integer-derived filter parameters; bounded subprocess timeout with partial logs
checks.claim_scope: Historical training reuse explicit; encoder execution and quality qualification absent; new_recording and production_activation false

limits: Audio index-to-source-time relation assumes continuous decoded audio from stream start; physical synchronization not proved
ffprobe inspects full-file metadata; this is not a real-time causal encoder pipeline
HISTORICAL_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE means diagnostic execution completed; accepted_hash_equal may remain false or null and must be reported separately
Frozen prior has resampled waveform SHA, not native PCM SHA; missing native reference remains null
